fields.Name: Collaboration: Visible Spaces
fields.Description: A space the caller owns, a space their active membership reaches, or the one space a magic-link scope names.
fields.FilterText: (OwnerID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) OR ID IN (SELECT SpaceID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))) OR CAST(ID AS NVARCHAR(450)) = '{{ScopeResourceID}}')

fields.Name: Collaboration: Visible Members
fields.Description: The caller's own roster rows, including Invited, and the rosters of spaces their active membership reaches.
fields.FilterText: (UserID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) OR SpaceID IN (SELECT SpaceID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))))

fields.Name: Collaboration: Visible Items
fields.Description: Shared items in a visible space, team items only when the reaching role has CanSeeTeamBand, and shared items in the one space a magic link names.
fields.FilterText: ((SpaceID IN (SELECT SpaceID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) WHERE CanSeeTeam = 1) OR (Band = N'Shared' AND SpaceID IN (SELECT SpaceID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))))) OR (Band = N'Shared' AND CAST(SpaceID AS NVARCHAR(450)) = '{{ScopeResourceID}}'))

fields.Name: Collaboration: Active Space Types
fields.Description: Space types are vocabulary, not content. Active types are readable. The filter is present so the role is not exempt from row-level security.

fields.Name: Collaboration: Active Space Roles
fields.Description: Role types are the flags the engine reads. Active roles are readable. The filter is present so the role is not exempt from row-level security.

fields.Name: Collaboration: Notices In Reach
fields.Description: Share notices for spaces the caller reaches.

fields.Name: Collaboration: Own Item Uses
fields.Description: The caller's own item uses, in spaces they reach.
fields.FilterText: (UserID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) AND SpaceID IN (SELECT SpaceID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER))))

fields.Name: Collaboration: People In Reach
fields.Description: The caller's own person, and people linked to a user with an active seat on a space the caller reaches.
fields.FilterText: (LinkedUserID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) OR LinkedUserID IN (SELECT m.UserID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[SpaceMember] AS m WHERE m.Status = N'Active' AND m.SpaceID IN (SELECT SpaceID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)))))
